projectDescription: A polished React-style multi-page enterprise web application for AI-powered tender quality control, frontend-first with mock services and architecture ready for future BIS and standards APIs.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Strongly typed React application with maintainable domain models and mock service contracts.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: React application using JavaScript without static type checking.

questions.rationale: The brief calls for a multi-page enterprise application with reusable components, domain models, and modular services; TypeScript provides the clearest contract boundary for that architecture.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and routing approach should be used?
questions.recommendedChoice: React with Vite and React Router
questions.answer: React with Vite and React Router

options.label: React with Vite and React Router
options.description: Fast frontend-first React application with explicit routes, reusable components, and mock service modules.

options.label: Next.js App Router
options.description: React framework with file-based routing and an upgrade path to server-rendered features.

questions.rationale: The requested routes, frontend-first scope, and future API readiness fit a Vite React shell with explicit client routing while keeping service boundaries modular.

questions.question: What should the frontend include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Deliver the complete StandardsGuard AI tender quality-control workflow from the brief.
questions.answer: Routes /login, /dashboard, /analyze, /tenders, /tenders/:id, /standards, /evidence, /reports, and /settings; proper auth redirect with demo login and no bypass; responsive light enterprise UI with dark typography and blue/indigo accents; reusable Navbar, Sidebar, DashboardCards, TenderHealth, IssueCard, EvidencePanel, StandardsTable, RequirementMatrix, RelationshipGraph, RevisionAssistant, ReportPreview, and UploadZone components; finite simulated processing steps with animation; evidence chain with distinct source, AI, and recommendation states; review-only revision assistant; standards explorer and relationship graph; tender requirement matrix; report generation UI; clearly labeled DEMO / Illustrative Standard data; modular mock services documentParser, requirementExtractor, standardRetriever, standardMatcher, issueDetector, evidenceMapper, revisionAssistant, and reportGenerator; domain models User, Tender, TenderRequirement, Standard, StandardClause, StandardRelationship, Analysis, Issue, Evidence, RevisionSuggestion, and Report; polished, intentional, professional expo-quality workflows rather than a landing page.
questions.rationale: This is the complete functional and visual scope supplied in the project brief.

sharedQuestions.question: Which data stores does this app require?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use local mock services and in-memory demo data; preserve service contracts for a future API and persistence layer.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational persistence for users, tenders, analyses, standards metadata, evidence, and reports.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for tender documents, evidence files, and generated report artifacts.

options.label: Redis
options.description: Caching and job-state support for future asynchronous analysis workflows.

sharedQuestions.rationale: The requested scope is frontend-first with mock services and no required persistence; future BIS or standards APIs can be integrated behind the existing service contracts later.

sharedQuestions.question: Should users sign in to access application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require the login route and redirect unauthenticated users to sign in before accessing the app.

options.label: No
options.description: Allow access without a sign-in flow.

sharedQuestions.rationale: The brief explicitly requires proper auth redirect and a demo login with no bypass.
